svg.title: goto, get_polygon and jump_polygon across lines
svg.desc: An agent finds the most anomalous transaction, moves onto it with goto, reads its polygon edges with get_polygon, and follows the edge to its account with jump_polygon. On the right, the transaction population and the account population; the polygon edges draw in and the position marker jumps along the accounts edge. Distance from each centroid is real; angles are illustrative.
svg.text: One polygon hop: a transaction to its account.
